# CASE-2026-041 — Representative Customer Complaint  
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | CASE-2026-041 |
| Document ID | CASE-041-COMPLAINT |
| Version | 1.0 |
| Received | 2026-07-06 |
| Owner | Complaints Manager |
| Status | Under investigation |
| Supersedes | None |
| Superseded By | None |
| Related Documents | [[case_2026_041_overview]], [[case_2026_041_incident_timeline]], [[case_2026_041_retention_decision]], [[policy_complaints_v3]], [[complaint_resolution_guide]] |  
The customer requests an account, impact explanation, compensation for distress, subject access, and erasure. Acknowledge, verify identity and accessibility needs, investigate individual exposure, and explain escalation rights.  
Do not describe the impact count as final: attribute 120 to Security potential impact and 118 to Operations confirmed impact if either is needed. Privacy and the Incident Commander must review communications.

raw_entities.name: CASE-2026-041 — Representative Customer Complaint
raw_entities.description: A formal complaint case opened on 2026-07-06 under the ownership of the Complaints Manager. The case encompasses a customer's multi-faceted request for account information, impact explanation, compensation for distress, subject access, and data erasure. Currently under investigation with related incident timeline and retention decision documents.
context: Case ID | CASE-2026-041
Owner | Complaints Manager
Status | Under investigation
The customer requests an account, impact explanation, compensation for distress, subject access, and erasure.

raw_entities.name: Customer Request for Account and Impact Explanation
raw_entities.description: The customer's formal request for an account and impact explanation regarding their exposure in the incident. This complaint seeks clarity on how the customer was affected and what data was involved.
context: The customer requests an account, impact explanation, compensation for distress, subject access, and erasure.
investigate individual exposure, and explain escalation rights

raw_entities.name: Customer Compensation Request for Distress
raw_entities.description: The customer's formal request for compensation in relation to distress caused by the incident. This complaint seeks financial redress for the impact and inconvenience suffered.
context: The customer requests an account, impact explanation, compensation for distress, subject access, and erasure.

raw_entities.name: Customer Subject Access Request
raw_entities.description: The customer's formal request for subject access to their personal data held by FirstUK Bank in connection with the incident. This is a data protection rights request under applicable data protection legislation.
context: The customer requests an account, impact explanation, compensation for distress, subject access, and erasure.

raw_entities.name: Customer Erasure Request
raw_entities.description: The customer's formal request for erasure of their personal data held by FirstUK Bank. This is a data protection rights request seeking deletion of data in connection with the incident.
context: The customer requests an account, impact explanation, compensation for distress, subject access, and erasure.

raw_entities.name: Security Initial Assessment — 120 Potentially Affected Customers
raw_entities.description: Security team's initial assessment of the incident scope, identifying 120 customers as potentially affected. This assessment is noted as preliminary and not final, pending reconciliation with Operations' confirmed count.
context: attribute 120 to Security potential impact and 118 to Operations confirmed impact if either is needed
Do not describe the impact count as final

raw_entities.name: Operations Confirmed Assessment — 118 Affected Customers
raw_entities.description: Operations team's reconciled assessment of the incident scope, confirming 118 customers as affected. This count differs from Security's initial potential impact assessment and represents the confirmed exposure.
context: attribute 120 to Security potential impact and 118 to Operations confirmed impact if either is needed
Do not describe the impact count as final

raw_entities.name: Identity Verification and Accessibility Needs Assessment
raw_entities.description: A required remediation step to verify the customer's identity and assess their accessibility needs as part of the complaint investigation and resolution process.
context: Acknowledge, verify identity and accessibility needs, investigate individual exposure, and explain escalation rights.

raw_entities.name: Individual Exposure Investigation
raw_entities.description: A required remediation step to investigate the specific exposure of the individual customer in relation to the incident, to support the impact explanation and complaint resolution.
context: Acknowledge, verify identity and accessibility needs, investigate individual exposure, and explain escalation rights.

raw_entities.name: Escalation Rights Explanation
raw_entities.description: A required remediation step to explain to the customer their escalation rights in relation to the complaint, including next steps and regulatory oversight options.
context: Acknowledge, verify identity and accessibility needs, investigate individual exposure, and explain escalation rights.

raw_entities.name: Privacy and Incident Commander Communications Review
raw_entities.description: A required remediation step mandating that Privacy and the Incident Commander review all communications with the customer before they are sent, ensuring compliance and consistency.
context: Privacy and the Incident Commander must review communications.
